title: Did not work for me personally
text: Did not work for me personally. I was so excited, this was a nice thick fluffy foam topper and I was hoping this would make my friends mattress (very hard and we are housesitting a lot there) much more bearable. The foam was thick enough for my hips to be ok sleeping on it, but you are sinking so far in, that as a sidesleeper, you have problems moving from one side to another. Once my hips were also so far sunk in, it felt like sleeping in a hammok with the head and feet much higher up. This sleeping position caused a lot of neck pain, so in the end, I'm not sure what is worse? I'm generally a warm sleeper, this was not cooling foam, I was sweating all night long. I think if you sleep cold and want to be warmer, this is great, I also think the thinner version might be good for back sleepers, not sure if this works for side sleepers though (not the 4" at least).
